# MOSS-VL-Realtime_Demo_App backend — MAIN environment (.venv)
# Target: GPU box (H200, driver CUDA 12.9), Python 3.12, internal Nexus PyPI mirror.
#
# This env runs: FastAPI gateway + HF online_streaming MOSS-VL + ASR adapter (FunASR
# SenseVoice) + TTS adapter client. It does NOT contain sglang/vllm — those are
# version-incompatible sidecars (sglang 0.5.10 pins torch 2.9.1 + transformers 5.3.0,
# while the MOSS-VL streaming processor code targets transformers 4.57.x).
# See requirements-sglang.txt for the offline-chat inference sidecar env.
# VLM_DEPLOY=sglang_omni uses an external realtime server. Install that server
# from https://github.com/fnlp-vision/sglang-omni-realtime in its OWN environment
# (SGLang 0.5.16 / Transformers 5.12.1 / torch 2.11). Do not merge its pins here.
# See requirements-vllm.txt for the vLLM-Omni TTS engine env (.venv-vllm,
# TTS_PROVIDER=vllm_omni): its vllm/torch pins
# also conflict with this env, so it installs from ../wheelhouse/vllm-omni
# into its OWN venv, never into .venv.
#
# Version rationale — PINNED TO MATCH THE BOARD'S ACTUAL REFERENCE ENV
# (captured 2026-07-03 from Box 1 `verl--cyx`, /opt/conda py3.12, `pip freeze`):
# - transformers==4.57.1 : MOSS-VL streaming modeling code (hf_mossvl_streaming_processor)
#   is written against the 4.55-4.57 API; MOSS-TTS-Nano also pins 4.57.1. (matches board)
# - torch==2.8.0+cu128 + torchcodec==0.7.0 + torchvision==0.23.0 + torchaudio==2.8.0 :
#   EXACT board pairing. (Earlier draft used the torch-2.9.1 stack derived from sglang
#   metadata; the board actually runs 2.8.0 — reverted to match, since the custom
#   streaming model + FA3 were built/validated against torch 2.8.)
# - flash-attn : board uses flash_attn 2.8.1 built for cu12/torch2.8 (attn_implementation
#   ="flash_attention_2"). It ALSO ships a Hopper-native flash_attn_3 built from source at
#   moss_vl_streaming/8B/train_fa3/Megatron-LM/flash-attention-src/hopper — a real perf win
#   on H200; build it separately (see build script). Fallback: attn_implementation="sdpa".
# - Board env has NO sglang/vllm installed → offline mode there runs on the HF path, not
#   sglang. Treat the sglang sidecar (requirements-sglang.txt) as an optional accelerator
#   we add, not something the reference depends on.

# Index config intentionally omitted — on the GPU box /etc/pip.conf points at the
# internal Nexus mirror (external mirrors time out from the air-gapped box).
# For +cu128 wheels use the board's index or the pytorch cu128 index.

# --- core DL stack (exact board pins) ---
torch==2.8.0
torchvision==0.23.0
torchaudio==2.8.0
torchcodec==0.7.0
transformers==4.57.1
accelerate>=1.10
safetensors
joblib

# --- server ---
fastapi>=0.115
uvicorn[standard]>=0.30
pydantic>=2.7
python-multipart>=0.0.9
websockets>=12.0
websocket-client>=1.8          # outbound WS client (OpenAI-realtime-style ASR engines)
requests>=2.32,<3              # direct dependency: omni health/model queries and memory clients
aiohttp>=3.9                   # async HTTP client for TTS/ASR sidecar adapters
psutil>=5.9                    # deployment process identity and bounded shutdown

# --- media / audio ---
pillow>=10.3
numpy>=1.26,<3
soundfile>=0.12
# NOTE: stdlib `audioop` exists on py3.12 (used for RMS VAD) but was removed in py3.13.
audioop-lts; python_version >= "3.13"

# --- ASR (default engine: FunASR SenseVoiceSmall + FSMN-VAD, local checkpoints) ---
funasr==1.3.14

# --- TTS sidecar client deps (MOSS-TTS-Nano runtime, third_party/MOSS-TTS-Nano) ---
sentencepiece>=0.1.99
WeTextProcessing>=1.0.4.1
onnxruntime>=1.20.0

# --- built separately by scripts/build_venv.sh (order matters, needs torch first) ---
# flash-attn==2.8.1  built for cu12/torch2.8  (board uses this exact build)
#   MAX_JOBS=48 pip install flash-attn==2.8.1 --no-build-isolation
# flash_attn_3 (Hopper): optional perf build from
#   /inspire/qb-ilm/project/video-understanding/public/train/moss_vl_streaming/8B/train_fa3/
#   Megatron-LM/flash-attention-src/hopper   (pip install -e . in that dir)
